prompt: Research current auth, draft two login redesign approaches, and wait for me before changing any code.
interpretation: You want a real picture of how login works today, two concrete redesign options with tradeoffs, and a hard stop before anyone edits the codebase.

nodes.label: Read current auth
nodes.summary: Collect how login, sessions, and password reset actually work in this repo.
nodes.instructions: Search the repo for auth routes, session storage, identity providers, and tests.

nodes.label: Read product constraints
nodes.summary: Find product notes that constrain a login change.
nodes.instructions: Look for docs and tickets about login and SSO.

nodes.label: Merge research
nodes.summary: One packet with as-is auth plus product constraints.

nodes.label: Draft each approach
nodes.summary: Write a one-page design for each selected approach.
nodes.instructions: For each approach, draft scope, files likely to change, migration steps, and rollback. Do not edit application code.

nodes.label: Your review
nodes.summary: Nothing is implemented until you pick an approach.
nodes.instructions: Present both drafts. Capture approve, edit, or reject.

loops.until: each selected approach has a one-page draft
